ledger: right hand and coin | holds coin above front cup at 00:00 | holds coin above left cup at 00:09 | dips into cup at 00:01, re-emerges at 00:02, presses coin to cup exterior at 00:04
left hand and coin | rests near back cup at 00:00 | slides coins on table at 00:09 | lifts coin at 00:03, touches outer cup at 00:05
four metal cups | arranged in staggered cluster at 00:00 | three cups aligned in a row at 00:08 | inner cups shift into a line without being pushed between 00:03 and 00:05

findings.description: The right hand lowers a coin into the front cup at 00:01, but the placement never completes; the coin re-emerges in the fingers at 00:02 and adheres to the outside of the cup at 00:04.
The coin resting on the middle cup vanishes and a new coin appears on the felt beside the front cup between 00:02 and 00:03 with no hand contact.
Between 00:03 and 00:05, the staggered cups align into a straight row even though the man's hands never push the inner cups.
